C1200.title: Datong Netizen Detained for Unauthorized AI Digital Human Livestreaming Using Cheng Li-wen’s Likeness
C1200.summary: China's Ministry of Public Security Cybersecurity Bureau reported that Xing, a netizen in Datong, Shanxi, used an AI digital human based on Cheng Li-wen's likeness without authorization for livestream sales, exploiting public attention to attract traffic and sell goods. Local police found that the conduct disrupted online order and violated public-security rules, imposed administrative detention, and warned against using AI to impersonate others for profit.
